title: When Does Context Help? A Systematic Study of Target-Conditional Molecular Property Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2604.06558v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present the first systematic study of when target context helps molecular property prediction, evaluating context conditioning across 10 diverse protein families, 4 fusion architectures, data regimes spanning 67-9,409 training compounds, and both temporal and random evaluation splits. Using NestDrug, a FiLM-based architecture that conditions molecular representations on target identity, we characterize both success and failure modes with three principal findings. First, fusion architecture dominates: FiLM outperforms concatenation by 24.2 percentage points and additive conditioning by 8.6 pp; how you incorporate context matters more than whether you include it. Second, context enables otherwise impossible predictions: on data-scarce CYP3A4 (67 training compounds), multi-task transfer achieves 0.686 AUC where per-target Random Forest collapses to 0.238. Third, context can systematically hurt: distribution mismatch causes 10.2 pp de

translated_title: 上下文何时有效？靶标条件化分子性质预测的系统性研究
translated_abstract: 我们首次对靶标上下文何时有助于分子性质预测进行了系统性研究，在10个不同的蛋白家族、4种融合架构、跨越67至9,409个训练化合物的数据规模，以及时间分割和随机分割两种评估方式下评估了上下文条件化。通过使用NestDrug——一种基于FiLM的架构，将分子表示条件化于靶标身份——我们以三项主要发现刻画了其成功与失败模式。第一，融合架构起主导作用：FiLM比拼接方法高出24.2个百分点，比加性条件化方法高出8.6个百分点；如何整合上下文比是否使用上下文更重要。第二，上下文使原本不可能的预测成为可能：在数据稀缺的CYP3A4靶标上（仅67个训练化合物），多任务迁移达到了0.686的AUC，而单靶标随机森林则骤降至0.238。第三，上下文也可能系统性地造成损害：分布失配会导致10.2个百分点的性能下降（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 本研究首次系统评估了靶标上下文条件化在分子性质预测中的作用，发现融合架构的选择至关重要（FiLM显著优于拼接与加性方法），上下文既能在低数据量靶标上实现原本不可能的多任务迁移预测，也可能因分布失配而系统性地损害性能。
en_tdlr: This first systematic study of target-conditional molecular property prediction shows that fusion architecture choice dominates (FiLM outperforms concatenation by 24.2 pp), context enables otherwise impossible predictions on data-scarce targets, but distribution mismatch can systematically hurt performance.
